description:
The whole brief as amended by one sentence of the reader's, compiled as set_brief does, with `changes`
against the one they hold. save_brief with the new `confirm` keeps it.

brief.description: The brief: the record in YAML or JSON (the schema at /start/brief.schema.json, the example at /start/brief.example.yaml); a plain name where no id is known is resolved.

language.description: The reader's language, ISO 639-1 (en, pl, sv, de, ...): names are looked up in it; our own text comes in en or pl, `read_in` says which.

name: amend_brief
title: Amend the brief
